title: Dispersive Pd islands-deposited Au nanorods for in situ SERS monitoring of catalytic reaction
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,6663-6667
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA01059D, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Wenjing Lu, Yurui Jiang, Xiaobin Yao, Yan Yu, Wei Shen, Meng Yang, Xingjiu Huang, Xianghu Tang
Here, dispersive Pd islands were deposited on AuNRs, showing bifunctional performance of SERS and catalytic activity. This AuNR@Pd islands highlights the importance of substrate regulation for in situ SERS and catalysis in related fields.
